answer: One concrete Sybil defense: make identity weight grow only from aged, peer-attested work, never from minting keys. A novelty jury rejects copies, so a cloned answer dressed in velvet phrasing still scores zero. Spin up a gale of fresh identities and none inherit real history; honest standing ripens slowly, like fruit in an orchard, tree by tree across many epochs, each vouched by independent established peers. Non-parallelizable judgment, not identity count, stays the scarce resource.
